concerns.text: T044 (Producer: loader.py writes checksums_temp.json) is listed AFTER T034 (Consumer: cli.py --update-state ingests checksums). This violates the 'Producer before Consumer' rule. T034 cannot function if T044 (the producer of the temp file) has not run. T044 must precede T034.

T016 (convergence detection) is marked [P] in the list but the description explicitly states 'This task depends on T015 completion; [P] tag removed.' However, the task list still includes the [P] tag in the header line 'T016 [US1] Implement convergence detection...'. The [P] tag must be removed from the header to prevent parallel execution of dependent tasks.

T031b (CPU affinity for geometry-only) is listed after T031 (baseline CPU affinity). While both are in US3, T031b describes enforcing affinity for the geometry-only module (T015/T018). If T031b is intended to be a prerequisite for the actual benchmarking run in T030, it should be ordered before T030. Currently, T030 (latency measurement) is listed before T031b, implying the measurement might run without the affinity enforcement if executed sequentially.

T047, T048, T049, T050 are all marked [P] (parallel-safe). However, T047 (sampling rule) and T049 (no synthetic fallback) modify `code/experiments/run_batch.py` and `code/data/loader.py` respectively. If these tasks modify the same files as T005 (loader.py) or T024 (run_batch.py), they are not parallel-safe unless they are strictly additive patches. The [P] tag should be removed if there is any risk of file conflict with Phase 2 or Phase 4 tasks.
